text:
Clara Nguyen: Quick check-in on the compact Create Team modal validation patterns. I prototyped 3 variations: (A) inline-on-blur with small "Required" label and reserved 18px space under fields; (B) submit-summary banner that anchors to fields; (C) hybrid that shows inline but collapses to banner below a height threshold. Constraints: modal height, keyboard flow, and SR semantics. Thoughts? Ben Ortiz: Inline-first. When error is right under the input people fix faster. The banner feels like a hidden drawer users might not see, especially on mobile. Sam Lee: I vote hybrid. On desktop inline is clearer; on very short modals the banner avoids pushing the primary CTA off-screen. If hybrid, we must be explicit about the breakpoint and behavior (e.g., height < 520px -> banner). Clara Nguyen: Agree. Two implementation checks: 1) reserve vertical space so errors don't cause layout jump; 2) when collapsing to banner, focus must move to the banner and it should announce the number of errors. DesignBot: Accessibility note: use role="alert" for inline messages and aria-live="polite" + tabindex="-1" for the banner. Ensure each banner link moves focus to the errored field and that field has aria-describedby pointing to the error node. Ben Ortiz: Copy nit: inline message -> "Team name is required" (actionable). Banner heading -> "2 issues need attention". Each item should be "Field name Fix" linking to the input. Keep language direct and consistent. Sam Lee: Required marker: asterisk alone is ambiguous for SR. Proposed: visually show asterisk but include a hidden "Required" span for screen readers. For the compact modal we can show the text "· Required" after the first label in a group and hide repeats visually. Clara Nguyen: Destructive flow: deleting a team that has billing or downstream hooks should require typed-confirm. For ephemeral things (invites, temporary tokens), modal + undo toast is fine. Typed-confirm microcopy: "Type DELETE to remove this team permanently." Make it case-insensitive and trim whitespace to avoid frustration. QA-bot: Acceptance checklist suggestion: 1) keyboard-only repro of submit -> focus lands on banner or first error; 2) screen reader reads banner count and then the error when link clicked; 3) VoiceOver/NVDA read order tested for collapsed modals; 4) no layout shift on error show. Ben Ortiz: Small ARIA snippet for the pattern library: ```

2 issues need attention

  • Team name required
Team name is required
``` This covers focus movement and announcements. Sam Lee: Also recommend reserving 18px under fields (CSS) and using opacity-only transitions for the error text to keep CTAs stable. Add a tiny visual emphasis like `.error-text { font-weight: 600; }` rather than heavy color reliance. Clara Nguyen: Proposed decision: default inline-on-blur for touched fields with reserved height; hybrid collapse to banner under short-modal breakpoint; required marker with sr-only "Required" text; typed-confirm only for high-risk deletes; modal+undo for others. I'll update the Patterns doc and attach Figma variants. Any objections? Ben Ortiz: None. Please include copy examples and the ARIA snippet. Sam Lee: No objections. I'll add mapping rules for server error keys -> data-field-id so anchors are deterministic. DesignBot: Logging accessibility follow-up: A11Y-6210. Checklist added to the doc. QA-bot: Logged QA ticket: QA-12088 (keyboard + SR acceptance tests). Clara Nguyen: Thanks team posting updated mocks and the spec shortly. End thread.
